parameters.apprise_url_plus: zulip://${ customer_secrets.{{ params.botname_secret }} }@${ customer_secrets.{{ params.organization_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.token_secret }} }
parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own Zulip destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-zulip` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). The gateway composes an Apprise `zulip://` URL from the credentials in your stored secrets and delivers the notification via apprise.unitysvc.dev, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Four channels are available. The free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters. The `gateway` and `gateway-plus` channels transform the envelope directly into a Zulip Messages API form body and post it to your Zulip organization (no Apprise). Pricing: the `gateway` channel is free (direct to your Zulip organization); the `gateway-plus` channel is $0.001 per message for extra per-enrollment Zulip destinations, delivered direct.
parameters.gateway_body_template: content={* _escape_json((_body.title or "")..(((_body.title or "")~="" and (_body.body or "")~="") and "\n" or "")..(_body.body or "")) *}&type=stream
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Zulip destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your Zulip organization (no Apprise)

base_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Zulip base URL

organization_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Zulip organization

token_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Zulip token
